name: Joseph Ungoco
office: City of Manhattan Beach, Member of the City Council

items.text: His campaign says he has served on the Manhattan Beach Planning Commission for seven years. He chaired the commission and also served as vice chair. His career includes health policy, federal consulting, and strategic communications, according to his campaign. He holds an MBA in health policy, his campaign says.

sentences.text: His campaign says he has served on the Manhattan Beach Planning Commission for seven years.
He chaired the commission and also served as vice chair.

items.text: He calls for fiscal discipline, with transparent project timelines, costs, and oversight. He opposes excessive height and density. He supports community policing, traffic safety, and e-bike enforcement. He proposes a lifetime limit of two four-year council terms, called “8 Is Enough.” On speed cameras, he supports police enforcement and is open to new ways to help police.
